hints.title: Prefix Sum Modulo
hints.text: Subarray sums between indices i and j are divisible by k when the difference between prefix sums is zero modulo k.

hints.title: Distinct Tracking
hints.text: Collect unique qualifying subarray sequences inside a uniqueness collection.

hints.title: Prefix Accumulation
hints.text: Precompute prefix sums to query range sum divisibility in constant time.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Prefix sum acceleration with distinct subarray collection.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-summing elements for each candidate subarray causes cubic O(N^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(N^2) space to store distinct subarray representations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use prefix sums to evaluate range sums modulo k and eliminate duplicate subarrays.
